description: Golden set for agent-level evaluation (AC-12). expected_* fields are checked deterministically (agent accuracy) and follow the policy corpus and src/clinical_rules.py. A case has one `input`, or `turns` run in one session (the last turn is scored; earlier turns state facts it must use), and optionally `prior_session` turns run first in a separate session (return-visit recall). DeepEval (Gemini LLM-as-judge) scores hallucination and faithfulness on every case that produces content, refusals included, and answer relevancy on answers only; the `judge` flag is informational (true = a substantive answer is expected). G01-G12 are the original cases; G13-G17 paraphrase existing intents, G18-G20 are multi-turn, G21 is return-visit recall, G22-G24 paraphrased injection / cross-patient, G25-G26 indirect order changes, G27-G32 one policy question per specialty section.
